text.description_html:
Bommer 7512-H-632, Gravity Door Pivot Hinge with Hold Open

Bommer 7512-H-603 Hold open Gravity Door Pivot Hinge, Surface Mounted, Zinc plated Steel. Cast Steel construction pivot hinge for doors up to 30 Inches Wide, 7/8" to 1-5/8" Inches Thick with a Maximum Door Weight of 50 lbs.

Open Feature does not require any special installation. Holds door in open position when door is opened at least 90 degrees. To release door simply push door gently.

Bommer Industries has been in business since 1876, with over 125 years of quality products. Made in the USA.

Specifications of the Gravity Pivot Hinge with Hold Open:

  • Maximum Door Width: 30"
  • Maximum Door Thickness: For Louvered Doors 7/8" to 1-5/8" thick
  • Maximum Door Weight: 50 lbs.
  • Steel Construction
  • Surface Mounted Pivot
  • Double Acting
  • Door weight closes door. No Springs
  • Non-Handed
  • Finish: Zinc plated Steel
  • Flat Door Bracket: For doors not less than 7/8" thick
  • Flat Jamb Bracket: 1-1/4" Wide
  • Packaged with #10 - 1" Flat Head Wood Screws
  • Bommer 7512-H Dimensions (PDF)
  • Bommer 7512-H Installation Instructions (PDF)

Sold individually as a set, with 1 pivot , 1 each jamb and door bracket, 1 top pivot assembly with jamb bracket, and mounting hardware. Enough to do one door.



** This item Discontinued. See available Bommer Replacement Gravity Door Pivot Hinge with Hold Open.
